lines.text: The pages you load live in buildings full of machines.
Here's one machine you're allowed to see: NASA's Pleiades supercomputer, in California.
A hundred and fifty-three racks. Ten thousand seven hundred and twenty-eight computers, wired together as one.
Two hundred and thirty-two thousand processor cores, and nine hundred terabytes of memory.
It ran from 2008 until December 2025. Then it was switched off.
So where is the video you're watching right now, and who's allowed in?
Level five of the full video goes inside. The link is just below.
